tools/verify-boot.js assembles the real application and compares what it
actually exposes against this list, in BOTH directions: a route that went
missing fails, and so does one that appeared. The second half matters as
much as the first - nothing says 'a module was registered twice', 'a path
drifted by a character' or 'somebody added a route without saying so' as
